def getrandbits(bits)
  result = 0
  shift = 0
  while bits.positive?
    word = genrand_uint32
    if bits < 32
      word >>= (32 - bits)
    end
    result |= word << shift
    shift += 32
    bits -= 32
  end
  result
end
